expect: ⚠ 4 warnings — none block. Client approval is a separate gate.
text: ⚠ 4 warnings — none block. Client approval is checked on this list, not after it.
why: UX-E-06 — 'All checks pass' can sit over a publish the server refuses. The approval gate becomes row 7 of the same list instead of a sentence excusing its absence.

why: UX-E-21 — surface the consequence where the decision to publish is made: the confirm counts pages, so it says which pages are dropped (ExportEngine.ts:645-660 isPageLive).

expect: One HTML file with styles inlined
